notes: A new look and a keyboard-first way of working. The app draws its own title bar, uses a bundled typeface and a dark green sidebar, and puts labels above fields. On every entry screen Enter moves to the next field or cell and adds a line off the end, Shift+Enter goes back, arrows move between lines, Ctrl+Enter adds a line, Ctrl+D deletes one and Esc backs out. Parties, products, accounts and brands are typed into the cell and chosen from a list that narrows as you type; Alt+N creates a new one without leaving the bill, and Ctrl+Space opens the full picker. Every number cell does arithmetic, such as 375*2067. Dates are typed as dd-mm-yyyy, with F2 to reach them. F5, F6 and F7 open a payment, receipt or journal voucher and F8 and F9 a sale or purchase bill from any list. Press ? for the full list of keys.
